question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- The items exceeding 500 are:
-- 531/Pallet of L -> 502/Bottle 500cl = 864
-- 532/Pallet of M -> 501/Bottle 330cl = 720
-- 533/Pallet Mix MS -> 502/Bottle 500cl = 600
-- 534/Pallet Mix SG -> 502/Bottle 500cl = 600

-- But wait, the question says "items" - maybe it means the actual products (beers) 
-- that are packed in these containers? Let me re-read...
-- "Which top-level packaging containers... have any item for which the total quantity 
-- accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500"
-- This seems to be about the packaging hierarchy itself, not products.
-- The "items" would be the leaf-level packaging (bottles).

-- Let me build this properly with a recursive CTE to compute the full hierarchy
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: top-level packaging (not contained in anything)
    SELECT 
        p.id as top_id,
        p.name as top_name,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        p2.name as current_name,
        pr.qty as qty,
        1 as level
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find what the current item contains
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        h.top_name,
        pr2.contains_id,
        p3.name,
        h.qty * pr2.qty,
        h.level + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr2 ON h.current_id = pr2.packaging_id
    JOIN packaging p3 ON pr2.contains_id = p3.id
)
SELECT 
    h.top_id,
    h.top_name,
    h.current_id as item_id,
    h.current_name as item_name,
    SUM(h.qty) as total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)  -- leaf nodes
GROUP BY h.top_id, h.top_name, h.current_id, h.current_name
HAVING SUM(h.qty) > 500
ORDER BY h.top_id, h.current_id
